headline: Anthropic Officially IPOs, Ajaib Crypto Offers XANT for Indonesian Investors
summary: Ajaib Kripto has launched the XANT token, which follows the price of Anthropic shares, giving Indonesian traders access to a global asset more easily.
why: Ajaib Kripto is a crypto trading platform in Indonesia, and tokenized products tied to foreign equities are a growing area of retail access.
original_headline: Anthropic Resmi IPO, Ajaib Kripto Hadirkan XANT untuk Investor RI
